verdict.rationale: Apple's macOS page documents Siri AI acting on natural-language requests. It can take actions in apps like Messages, Music and Reminders, answer and act on what's on screen, and draft text from a plain description. Siri is also reachable from Spotlight via "Ask Siri", with examples like editing a sent message or adding a song to a playlist. missing for 10: evidence of system-wide natural-language control beyond the named apps (e.g., settings, files, window management), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how reliably the actions work.
